ASTRA ULTRA — checkpoint02,9October2026 (Australia/Brisbane)

The foundational10/10 objective remains unachieved. No major longstanding
problem or general arbitrary-channel classicality theorem was resolved.
This checkpoint contains complete internal proofs for structured channel
classes, exact counterexamples to several proof shortcuts, and preserved
unresolved obligations. Historical novelty is not established. No external
expert validation, peer review or proof-assistant kernel replay occurred.

STRONGEST CURRENT RESULTS

For the classes below, one canonical pure-ensemble entanglement-breaking
channel Psi satisfies the sharp comparison

  tau(A^2)-tau(A Psi(A)) <=2[tau(A^2)-tau(A Phi(A))]

simultaneously over the stated observable domain; tau=Tr/d. The comparator
is fixed before A is selected. It is unital, CPTP and HS-self-adjoint.
Input channels and their legal equal-marginal broadcasters are supplied.

1. Full algebras in every dimension: defining-O(d)-covariant channels
   Phi_ab(X)=tau(X)I+a(X-X^T)/2+b[(X+X^T)/2-tau(X)I], d>=3.
   An actual mixture of real and circular pure-state orbits dominates
   2|Phi|-I as a Hilbert-Schmidt operator. Signed finite tensor products,
   mixtures and supplied bistochastic adjoint sandwiches preserveC2.
   An elementary contraction-star calculation, exact CP inequalities,
   and the orbit covariance profiles prove the result. The theorem has
   an independent all-d reconstruction, exposed audit PASS and exact
   symbolic checks. A denominator-placement clarification is recorded.
   The qutrit special case also has explicit21-atom and independently
   derived18-atom comparators. No general sufficient characterization
   of self-compatibility is asserted by our scalar conditions.

2. Arbitrary unital self-compatible qubit factors, including non-selfadjoint
   channels: any finite product has the same sharpC2 on the FULL global
   Hermitian algebra, including entangled observables. More generally the
   theorem covers products of supplied Clifford and vector-spin1 spans,
   with local leakage allowed. Two actual global product ensembles are
   mixed: one from right singular spaces, one from left singular spaces.
   A polar positive-semidefinite identity controls skew terms without a
   factor depending on the number of sites. Independent theorem-first
   reconstruction and exposed adversarial audit PASS. Naively tensori
